name: Villaverde de Medina (Spain)
description: Green field with a white cross throughout, charged with yellow castles at the upper hoist and lower fly and yellow vine leaves at the upper fly and lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Villaverde de Medina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: castles in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters
vine leaves in the upper fly and lower hoist quarters
